contentHtml:
There’s no better way to explore the stunning scenes of Abu Dhabi than behind the wheel. For adventurers and open road enthusiasts that live deep in our hearts, a rental car gives you the freedom to check out the city’s busy spots and peaceful corners. Create a travel experience that’s entirely your own.

So, buckle up. We’re hitting the highways and roundabouts to uncover the must-visit Abu Dhabi tourist spots that will leave you completely mesmerized.

  • Which Abu Dhabi tourist places should be on your bucket list?
  • Why is IZI the best provider for car rental selection?

All the Abu Dhabi Tourist Places You Can’t Miss

Like a race car on an open highway, we give you the freedom to go wherever you want, fast. And where else would you wish to go first, other than the very Abu Dhabi tourist places? We’ve even got a whole list for you to plan your road trip around.

Yas Island — A Paradise for Thrill Seekers

Is it even a surprise that Yas Island is on top of our list for Abu Dhabi tourist places? This is where fun and adrenaline collide. Be it roaring engines at Yas Marina Circuit’s Formula 1 races or Ferrari World’s heartstopping roller coasters, this island is a dream for every thrill seeker alive. And let’s not forget Yas Waterworld’s wild slides and wave pools either.

For shopaholics, Yas Mall offers quite the retail therapy. Whereas Yas Beach provides a pleasant escape with stunning views.

Make your adventure smoother with IZI Rent a Car’s affordable rental services. With convenience and value in your corner, you won’t miss a single pit stop on this island that’s packed with adventures.

Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque — A Majestic Icon

A trip to Abu Dhabi isn’t complete without marveling at the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. With its gleaming white domes, finer details, and serene gardens, this architectural masterpiece is a spiritual haven as well as a photographer’s paradise. The mosque’s reflective pools and chandeliers make it a sight to behold.

Arriving by car means you can soak it all in at your own pace. Don’t forget to check out nearby Abu Dhabi tourist attractions, as IZI takes the stress out of your travel plans.

Saadiyat Island — Where Culture Meets Tranquility

For a perfect mix of art and relaxation, Saadiyat Island delivers. The Louvre Abu Dhabi is a museum. But calling it a work of art would be more fitting, as it houses treasures from all across the globe.

When you’re ready to unwind, the island’s clear beaches offer a slice of paradise. Saadiyat also hosts art exhibitions and cultural events. That makes it quite the center for creative souls.

With our reliable rental car services, you can cruise to Saadiyat and beyond. Maybe even take a detour to tourist spots in Ajman. 

Corniche Road — Scenic Drives Along the Coast

An 8-kilometer stretch of pure coastal bliss, that’s what Abu Dhabi Corniche is. You’ve got to humor us for a second and picture this with us:
There are turquoise waters on one side, and then there are manicured gardens on the other. Not to forget, a skyline that’ll leave you in awe. You can stop for a stroll. Take a refreshing dip in designated beach areas. Or grab a bite at a charming cafe lining the promenade. What a dream.

Hit the road in style. Turn every drive into a new adventure. Be it a leisurely evening cruise or a daytime escapade, the Corniche never disappoints.

Al Ain Oasis — A Glimpse of Tradition

Escape the city buzz and venture into Al Ain. This Garden City happens to be a UNESCO World Heritage site, as well. It offers shaded pathways, ancient irrigation systems, and a peaceful retreat that contrasts beautifully with the urban vibe that Abu Dhabi has.

Nearby, you can explore Al Ain Zoo. Or visit the historic Al Jahili Fort to take a look at the deeper connection to Emirati heritage.

Driving here gives you the freedom to explore nearby gems such as Sharjah tourist places without a hitch. Ditch the stress of road travel with our car rentals. Instead, focus on soaking in the charm of Al Ain.

Emirates Palace — A Luxurious Landmark

Step into the lap of luxury that is Emirates Palace. It is not only a hotel. We will call it an entire experience. From its golden interiors and sprawling gardens to a private beach, you’ll find it an epitome of opulence.
Dine at world-class restaurants. Or enjoy a cup of their signature gold flaked cappuccino.

Arrive in style with an IZI rental car. When practicality meets sophistication, it makes your lavish outing even better. The surrounding area also offers stunning views that are perfect for evening drives.

Qasr Al Watan — The Presidential Palace

Experience royalty at Qasr Al Watan, Abu Dhabi’s Presidential Palace. Its stunning architecture and history make it a must-visit destination. The detailing of its halls and the illuminating library offer a glimpse into the UAE’s cultural and intellectual legacy. Nearby parks and gardens add to the charm of this regal destination.
Take your time traversing the grandeur without worrying about transport constraints. 

Liwa Desert — The Ultimate Road Trip Destination

If adventure is calling, the Liwa Desert is your answer. Golden dunes stretch endlessly, setting the stage for dune bashing, camel trekking, and unforgettable stargazing. Don’t forget to visit the historic Liwa Forts or participate in a falconry session for an authentic desert experience.

A sturdy rental car is your best friend here, and IZI Rent a Car’s fleet is up for the challenge. Pack your essentials and let the desert magic take over. Pro tip: Start early to catch the sunrise—it’s breathtaking.

Al Hudayriyat Island — Where Adventure Meets Relaxation

For something offbeat, head to Al Hudayriyat Island. With cycling tracks, kayaking, and glamping options, it’s the right mix of action and calm. The island’s clear beaches and adventure parks make it a favorite for families and solo travelers alike.

Driving here means you can pack all your gear and make the most of this hidden gem on your Abu Dhabi itinerary. Don’t forget to try the local food trucks for a delicious ending to your day of exploration.

Wrapping Up Your Abu Dhabi Adventure

Hitting Abu Dhabi tourist places by car will take you on an exciting trip. From cultural landmarks to luxurious retreats, thrilling islands to serene oases, every corner is an adventure waiting to happen.

So, start your engines. And let Abu Dhabi’s wonders unfold before you, mile by mile. With us, every road trip becomes unforgettable.

FAQs for Abu Dhabi Tourist Places

What are the top attractions to visit in Abu Dhabi by car?

In Abu Dhabi, don’t miss:

  • Yas Island
  • Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
  • Saadiyat Island
  • Corniche Road
  • Emirates Palace, and
  • Liwa Desert.

Why is hiring a rental car ideal for exploring Abu Dhabi?

Hiring a car rental is a wise choice to explore Abu Dhabi. It gives you freedom and convenience. You can comfortably drive and explore every corner stress-free.

Can I visit cultural landmarks like the Sheikh Zayed Mosque and the Louvre by car?

Driving these places means you can take your time. You have a chance to explore nearby spots. Having your car is the right way to avoid rigid tour schedules.

Is the Liwa Desert a good destination from Abu Dhabi city?

Liwa Desert is absolutely perfect for a road trip. You can enjoy yourself there:

  • Dune bashing
  • Camel rides
  • Forts, and
  • Epic desert sunrises.

Are Yas Island and Saadiyat Island accessible by rental car?

Both Yas Island and Saadiyat Island are easy to reach. They offer many exciting adventures, like:

  • Theme parks
  • Beaches
  • Malls, and
  • Cultural spots.
